title: 2.2 Measurement and Safety
description: Measurement and Safety concepts and applications. Hard level, 20 questions.

questions.question: A student reports a length as 8 m and 40 cm. Which single expression in centimeters is correct?
A tape reads 3.25 m for a classroom width. What is that in millimeters?
A measured value is 9.65 cm plus 8.4 cm. Which recorded result follows the addition rule?
A calculation gives 17.75845 from $8.65	imes2.053$. Which reported result is correct?
Which expression matches a radius of Earth of 6371000 m using a prefix?
Which expression matches a hydrogen atom diameter of 10 nm in meters?
A floor has area 40 square meters and one tile covers 0.25 square meters. How many tiles are needed?
A student measures a table as 200 cm. Which expression in kilometers is correct?
Which set of measurements uses appropriate units for a swimming pool?
options: Meters for length and kilograms for water mass
Millimeters for length and grams for water mass
Kilometers for length and milligrams for water mass
Centimeters for length and tonnes for water mass
questions.correctAnswer: Meters for length and kilograms for water mass

questions.question: A lab group wears goggles, avoids jewelry and reports a minor spill. Which rule have they all followed?
options: Significant figure rules in the unit
Graph plotting rules in the textbook

questions.question: A scientist needs the most precise reading among three rulers with 1 mm, 5 mm and 1 cm divisions. Which should be chosen?
Which description matches a ratio scale?
options: It permits multiplication and division as well as addition and subtraction
It permits labeling only now in this topic in the textbook of this subject
It gives ranks only as well in the textbook of this subject in experiments
It has no zero point as well in this topic in the textbook of this subject
questions.correctAnswer: It permits multiplication and division as well as addition and subtraction

questions.question: A student writes 0.000001256 in scientific notation to three decimal places. Which result is correct?
A mass reading sums to 2275.8 g. What is it in kilograms?
Which safety action involves electrical equipment?
options: Exercising caution while using it now
Tasting it in physics in the textbook
Wearing sandals near it in this topic
Leaving it switched on overnight here
questions.correctAnswer: Exercising caution while using it now

questions.question: A student compares a palm measure of cotton with a standardized kilogram. Which advantage of standards is illustrated?
options: Results become reproducible across people and places
The cotton becomes heavier in physics in experiments
Measurement becomes unnecessary here in the textbook
Only one person can measure in class in the textbook
questions.correctAnswer: Results become reproducible across people and places

questions.question: Which quantity is a base quantity with SI unit Kelvin?
A student must express 72 gigameters with a prefix symbol. Which form is correct?
Which statement about an estimated digit is accurate?
options: It is the final digit read between scale marks
It is always zero for students in the textbook
It is written before the decimal point as well
It is removed from every measurement in nature
questions.correctAnswer: It is the final digit read between scale marks

questions.question: A measured value of 138.0 is divided by 11.9. Which result respects the significant-figure rule?
options: 11.6 in this topic in the textbook
questions.correctAnswer: 11.6 in this topic in the textbook
